faqs.question: What does the Fungal stain test - Nail measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal infections in nail samples using a special staining technique that uses KOH & Calcofluor White stain.

faqs.question: Why is the Fungal stain test - Nail done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose fungal nail infections accurately • To differentiate between fungal infection and other conditions that can cause similar nail changes • To guide appropriate treatment decisions • To monitor the effectiveness of antifungal therapy

faqs.question: When is the Fungal stain test - Nail recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for individuals who • have discoloured, thickened, or brittle nails suggestive of a fungal infection, • are at a higher risk due to factors such as diabetes, immunosuppression, or previous fungal infections, • require confirmation of fungal infection for appropriate treatment, or • need monitoring during or after antifungal therapy.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Fungal stain test - Nail are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of a fungal infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Fungal stain test - Nail?
faqs.answer: During the test, a small sample of the affected nail will be collected in a sterile container. The sample will be sent to the laboratory for processing by staining it with KOH and Calcofluor White.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Fungal stain test - Nail?
faqs.answer: • Follow any specific instructions provided by your healthcare provider. • Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Fungal stain test - Nail?
faqs.answer: • Fungal culture: This test helps in identifying the specific fungus causing the infection. • Histopathology: A microscopic examination of a nail biopsy to evaluate for signs of fungal infection or other abnormalities.

faqs.question: What is the Fungal stain by KOH & Calcofluor White stain - Nail also known as?
faqs.answer: Nail Fungus Stain or Nail Fungal Culture

faqs.question: What is a fungal nail infection?
faqs.answer: A fungal nail infection, also known as onychomycosis, is a common condition caused by different types of fungi. It can lead to discolouration, thickening, and brittleness of nails.
